g.text: boundaries: first reaching each path count
How traversal changes the rate of bug discovery

One fixed chart and bug population per row. A joint test can change several paths. Reaching every path does not exhaust its values. Right panels stop at the first test reaching each path count. Deterministic strategies repeat identically across seeds.
